name: Jugeodo Joa!
source:
Your AI just sent out 3,000+ job applications—WITHOUT ASKING YOU!

It's 2222, automation swallowed the whole world. Jobs hardly exist. You are just one of the normals--another unemployed citizen in a system run by machines. But your job application changes everything.

Suddenly, three beautiful and powerful women seek you out. Each of them claims you belong by her side, though none of them reveal their true motives.

They each have a reason that sounds fair. But something doesn't add up—and the closer you get, the less any of it makes sense. Their ambitions push and pull you into different stories and conflicts, and somehow you're in the middle of everything.

Is this really about a job? Or were you chosen for something else?

As events unfold, the truth behind this automated world—and your unexpected role within it—gradually comes to light.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4462130/]Steam[/url]]
